requirements_for_validated_moat: working production or isolated prototype evidence
documented alternatives and prior art search

claims.label: PRIOR_ART_REVIEW_REQUIRED
claims.problem: financial actions cross identity, custody, policy, execution and settlement domains whose evidence is fragmented and difficult to audit
claims.proposed_differentiator: one privacy-minimized content-bound passport links intent, lane, custody, consent, deterministic risk, provider execution and reconciliation without carrying credentials or granting action authority
current_evidence: existing versioned intent and evidence contracts

claims.label: DIFFERENTIATED
claims.problem: users confuse private exchange, external CEX and self-custody balances and identity obligations
claims.proposed_differentiator: every action explicitly binds executor, identity/KYC authority and custody owner before confirmation
current_evidence: deployed market lane contract and UI

claims.label: DIFFERENTIATED
claims.problem: AI and external risk systems can accidentally broaden permissions or convert uncertainty into approval
claims.proposed_differentiator: advisory output can only tighten deterministic hard gates and every timeout, malformed result or conflict fails closed
current_evidence: frozen E2 decision and shadow contracts

claims.label: DIFFERENTIATED
claims.problem: retries and uncertain signer outcomes can duplicate or lose financial actions
claims.proposed_differentiator: immutable intent, isolated signer, terminal review on uncertainty and idempotent reconciliation/outbox form one auditable money boundary
current_evidence: deployed payout worker and intent stores
